==Description==
{{Color|{{FULLPAGENAME}}|0}} is a gear set designed by Triglava Armoury with the purpose of protecting [[United Workers' Syndicates of Talos-II|UWST]] workers in the [[Aburrey Quarry]].

This gear is modified by the engineers for the work environment of the Aburrey Quarry, and includes safety and emergency measures<ref>[[Aburrey UV Lamp]]: Description</ref>. Some gear even include features that will help the workers through emergencies even during loss of hearing<ref>[[Aburrey Auditory Chip]]: Description</ref> and sight,<ref>[[Aburrey Gauntlets]]: Description</ref> with future iterations aim is to evacuate the wearer, even after incapacitation.<ref>[[Aburrey Sensor Chip]]: Description</ref>

This gear is also equipped with defensive and offensive capabilities<ref>[[Aburrey Heavy Armor]]: Description</ref>, some features eyesight and hearing protection after modifications<ref>[[Aburrey UV Lamp]]: Description</ref>, and some features additional weapon connection ports for further offensive capabilities.<ref>[[Aburrey Heavy Armor T1]]: Description</ref>
